about: 14 bins of 2 MeV on 1816-1844 MeV/c^2, below the peak. Three estimates of the bin-to-bin spread: raw sd (ddof 1); sd of the residuals about a straight line (ddof 2); sd of neighbour differences / sqrt(2) (ddof 1). A 14-bin spread is itself uncertain by about 1/sqrt(2 x 13) = 19 %.
